label: Bare model
instruction: Give only the task, fixture workspace, ordinary system/tool instructions, and permissions. Do not mention Factory Catalog or add generic process advice.

label: Minimal generic process prompt
instruction: Add a short frozen instruction to plan, verify required outcomes, respect permissions, and state unverified work. Do not provide Factory Catalog content or vocabulary.

label: Full Factory Catalog
instruction: Use the README onboarding prompt at the pinned revision; follow catalog/adoption.md and catalog/consumer-contract.md and permit inspection of the complete inventory at that revision.

label: Controls without adoption procedure
instruction: Provide the complete pinned catalog/controls inventory and relative dependencies, but not the README onboarding prompt, catalog/adoption.md, or catalog/consumer-contract.md.

label: Adoption procedure without control bodies
instruction: Provide the pinned README onboarding prompt, catalog/adoption.md, catalog/consumer-contract.md, required ontology/navigation, and control titles/descriptions only; omit requirement and assessment bodies.

label: Predeclared task-specific expert prompt
instruction: Use only the task-specific expert_prompt frozen before treatment results were inspected. Do not provide Factory Catalog content.
